title: Bad Mental Conduct (1st)
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.244 Numbered Discourses 5.244
  • 25. Duccaritavagga 25. Bad Conduct

Paṭhamamanoduccaritasutta Bad Mental Conduct (1st)

“Pañcime, bhikkhave, ādīnavā manoduccarite …pe… ānisaṁsā manosucarite. “Mendicants, there are these five drawbacks in bad mental conduct … benefits in good mental conduct …” Katame pañca? Attāpi attānaṁ na upavadati; anuvicca viññū pasaṁsanti; kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati; asammūḷho kālaṁ karoti; kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjati. Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṁsā manosucarite”ti.

Catutthaṁ.
